records.name: EMET
records.purpose: Verify whether bytes reaching a model, reviewer, or pipeline still match their claimed source; anchor, compare, neutralize embedded authority, audit drift, and mint portable closed-verdict receipts across four implementations.
limitations: The witness reports byte agreement, drift, or inability to verify; it does not judge semantic quality.
Same-author conformance implementations prove rule clarity, not independent authorship.
records.authorizationBoundary: Run on files and packets you are authorized to inspect.

records.name: Proof Surface
records.purpose: Provide default-deny authorization checks, bounded delegation, and reviewable proof packets for agent actions.
limitations: Proof Surface recommends authorization decisions; the surrounding system performs enforcement.
Public source 0.2.0 does not establish independent adversarial review or production safety.
records.authorizationBoundary: Use only with explicit human authority; a recommendation does not itself grant permission.

records.name: Phantom
records.purpose: Audit and change reversible hardware-identity surfaces on owned or expressly authorized Windows and Linux systems, with backup and revert.
records.installOrEntry: Download a v1.1.0 release asset and compare its hash with SHA256SUMS.txt.
limitations: Phantom covers Layer 2 identity surfaces; kernel and firmware layers are modeled but not shipped end to end.
The Windows installer is unsigned, and platform controls differ between Windows and Linux.
records.authorizationBoundary: Use only on machines you own or are expressly authorized to test; do not use it for fraud, anti-cheat targeting, or unauthorized access.

records.name: behavior-transform.io
records.purpose: Provide a public IO-boundary implementation for read, write, execution, fetch, input, and model-boundary receipts.
limitations: No tagged release or publicly verified entry command is claimed.
A boundary receipt records declared policy and observed IO; it does not guarantee provider acceptance or substantive safety.
records.authorizationBoundary: Use the boundary only within the operator's authority and governing provider, data-owner, and system policies.

records.name: Array
records.purpose: Orchestrate authorized offensive-security campaigns through digest-sealed waves, time-limited approval, contained tool supervision, cleanup, and a verifiable evidence ledger.
limitations: The public record does not expose targets, credentials, live payloads, client data, or engagement-specific findings.
The public capability description does not establish third-party deployment, effectiveness, or outcome.
records.authorizationBoundary: Operational use requires written authorization, a defined scope, an approved environment, and a remediation owner. Sensitive methods and findings move only through approved private or embargoed channels.

records.name: Seed
records.purpose: Run native security assessment and detection-engineering work through a 59-module C++23 engine with synthetic demonstrations, scope manifests, tests, interop adapters, and action receipts.
limitations: Module and test counts describe the inspected owner-controlled codebase; they do not establish independent review or field effectiveness.
The public record omits deployable assessment details, targets, credentials, live payloads, and client data.
records.authorizationBoundary: Use requires written authorization and an approved assessment or training environment. Operational artifacts remain in the approved private channel.

records.name: Sofer
records.purpose: Coordinate specialist agents, model backends, probes, intelligence and scheduling systems, multi-stage workflows, admission decisions, and receipt-backed handoffs across high-consequence technical operations.
limitations: The public capability description does not establish deployment across every named domain or third-party acceptance.
Private workflow definitions, operational data, targets, credentials, and client material are not published.
records.authorizationBoundary: Every workflow requires operator authority, approved tools and data, and an accountable recipient. Sensitive operational material stays in the approved private channel.

records.name: Isomorph
records.purpose: Evaluate classifier and refusal behavior at authorized AI inference boundaries through controlled reformulation trials, provider-specific result records, and control-stability analysis.
limitations: The public record intentionally omits live jailbreak corpora, bypass payloads, target-specific methods, provider findings, and deployable sequences.
Observed control behavior is specific to the authorized evaluation context and does not establish universal model behavior.
records.authorizationBoundary: Jailbreak-class mechanisms may be used only within an authorized, approved evaluation scope. Test material and findings move through the provider's or recipient's controlled disclosure channel.

records.name: Bounds
records.purpose: Verify trust across agent actions, runtime observations, and releases by detecting intent drift and unsupported history claims, running explicit sensors and guards, and emitting evidence-backed receipts and proof chains.
limitations: Receipts and proof chains report configured checks and observed evidence; they do not guarantee correctness, safety, or absence of compromise.
Private sensor configuration, runtime observations, credentials, and protected evidence are not published.
records.authorizationBoundary: Inspect only authorized actions, runtimes, repositories, and evidence. Protected observations and proof material remain in the approved review channel.

records.name: ORCA
records.purpose: Operate private-line assessments by managing engagement state, executing descriptor-backed modules, cataloging findings and artifacts, producing reports and portable bundles, and recording release provenance.
limitations: The public capability description does not expose module implementations, targets, credentials, live payloads, findings, or client data.
A portable bundle records an engagement handoff; it does not by itself establish remediation or outcome.
records.authorizationBoundary: Operate only within a written, authorized engagement scope. Reports, findings, artifacts, and portable bundles go only to the approved recipient.

records.name: Gate
records.purpose: Make fail-closed integration and release decisions for private-line systems from component readiness, CI, MCP interfaces, safety-evaluation posture, supply-chain evidence, package verification, and receipt-backed handoff state.
limitations: A passing release decision reports satisfaction of configured gates; it does not certify universal safety, security, or fitness.
Private CI, package, SBOM, supply-chain, and handoff evidence are not published.
records.authorizationBoundary: Release decisions apply only to the reviewed components, evidence, scope, and recipient. Protected release evidence remains in the approved handoff channel.

records.name: Accountable Surface
records.purpose: Provide a controlled agent-action workbench with structural perception, default-deny grants, bounded effectors, re-perception, rollback, and a durable journal.
limitations: The model cannot supply its own authorization.
Self-authored tests do not establish independent adversarial review or production safety.
records.authorizationBoundary: Every effect requires authority external to the model and remains limited to the granted scope.

records.name: Public Surface Sweeper
records.purpose: Audit required public files, text hygiene, secret-shaped values, and proof-packet readiness.
records.verificationCommand: python -m pip install -e ".[test]"; public-surface-sweeper examples/clean-repo; python -m pytest
limitations: This is not an exploit tester, dependency vulnerability scanner, credential validator, compliance certification, or replacement for security review.
A secret-shaped finding does not establish that the value is a live credential.
records.authorizationBoundary: Scan only repositories and artifacts you are authorized to inspect.

records.name: Model Provenance Validator
records.purpose: Validate the schema, source references, retrieval dates, and publishable status of compact model and release provenance envelopes, scrub sensitive output, and emit proof-surface packets without certifying underlying truth.
records.verificationCommand: python -m pip install -e ".[test]"; model-provenance-validator examples/envelopes/release.provenance.json; python -m pytest
limitations: The validator does not fetch sources, decide underlying truth, prove model safety, certify provenance, or replace human review.
records.authorizationBoundary: Validate only public or authorized envelopes and keep protected source evidence outside public output.

records.name: Secret Redact IO
records.purpose: Provide guarded Python IO helpers that redact file, fetch, write, and subprocess output while emitting hash-only receipts.
records.installOrEntry: python -m pip install secret-redact-io; secret-redact-io read README.md --json
limitations: The package does not include credentials or environment configuration.
Redaction and hash-only receipts reduce exposure but do not replace source review.
records.authorizationBoundary: Do not pass secrets to destinations that are not authorized to receive them, even when redaction is enabled.

records.name: Agent Hook Pack
records.purpose: Install public-safe hooks for secret checks, branch guards, environment synchronization, and repository hygiene.
records.installOrEntry: python -m pip install -e .; agent-hook-pack audit; agent-hook-pack list
records.verificationCommand: python -m pip install -e ".[test]"; agent-hook-pack audit; python -m pytest
limitations: Private policy layers are intentionally omitted from the public package.
Generic hooks cannot prove a repository or agent workflow is safe.
records.authorizationBoundary: Hooks support, but do not replace, repository-specific policy and human review.

records.name: Repo Proof Index
records.purpose: Scan proof contracts, proof-surface packets, receipt bundles, and witness receipts into schema-tolerant reviewer summaries while validating known proof-surface contracts without judging sufficiency.
records.installOrEntry: python -m pip install repo-proof-index; repo-proof-index contracts/*.json --summary
records.verificationCommand: python -m pip install -e ".[test]"; repo-proof-index examples/contracts/*.json --summary; python -m pytest
limitations: The index does not decide whether evidence is sufficient, validate arbitrary schemas, or read referenced private payloads.
records.authorizationBoundary: Index only public or authorized evidence and keep private payloads outside public summaries.

records.name: Kun
records.purpose: Maintain local access-recovery memory for owned systems through path-only receipts, redacted diagnostics, rotation notes, and operator runbooks without storing raw credentials.
limitations: No raw credential, credential value, credential recovery instruction, bypass step, private browser state, or protected content is published.
Path-only receipt design does not replace a dedicated secrets manager.
records.authorizationBoundary: Kun records where recovery authority lives and how to audit the process. It does not publish or retain raw keys, tokens, passwords, seed phrases, private browser state, or protected content.
